page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Marginal notes stand in the left margin, beside "Ephes.4." and "1.Cor.9." Running head at the top centre, page number at the top left. No catchword. A small mark near the foot is uncertain and is left out.

page.notes: Printed "Ephes.4." appears as "Ephef.4." with long s. Hyphenated "bo-rum" is restored as "bonorum". Line-end "abscef-ferint" is hard to read; the verb is doubtful. "studeamus" opens the page mid-sentence, so the first paragraph is a continuation. A small mark near the foot is uncertain and not recorded. The running head is spaced as "E R E N I C V M" and may begin "EI".
